title: Golden vectors of the Sail model (conformance/model/<profile>.json), spec version 0.1
description: Written by tools/gen_model_vectors.py from tsp_sim --trace. A vector is a program (SRAM preload, the text of the queues, words to dump) and the model's results (every diagnostic in order, every dumped word, and the trace of stream-register and SRAM writes with their values). An implementation passes a vector when it produces exactly expect.diagnostics (same cycle, queue and code, in the same order), exactly expect.words, and the trace whose digest is expect.trace_sha256. Checked by test/isa_db/check_conformance_schema.py; documented in porting-guide.md sec. 2.

profile.description: config/<profile>.json the vectors were generated with. An implementation conforms to a profile when it matches the vectors generated from that profile's configuration by the frozen model (porting-guide.md sec. 2.2); a profile without a committed file gets its vectors from `tools/gen_model_vectors.py` and the same model

config_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the profile's configuration file as canonical JSON (keys sorted, separators , and :, ASCII): lets an implementation check that it runs the profile of these vectors

text.description: Human-readable form of the vectors' text field

event.description: A trace line without its leading "T ": `srf <cycle> <row>:<stream> gap <gap> <value>` or `sram <cycle> slice <slice> addr <addr> <value>`; the value is vlanes bytes as lower-case hex pairs, lane 0 first (microarchitecture.md sec. 12)

word.description: One SRAM word, lane 0 first, two lower-case hex digits per lane byte; vlanes bytes (16 x geometry.superlanes)

code.description: A diagnostic code of encoding.json diagnostics

queue_key.description: "<queue>", decimal: 0..143 is a data queue, 65535 the control channel

units.description: The 32-bit units of a queue's initial instruction queue (assembly.md sec. 4, text format), 8 lower-case hex digits each, one space between units; at most icu.iq_depth / 4 units, none of them the padding unit ffffffff

instructions.description: Catalogue names of the entries the text uses, sorted: an instruction of the text uses an entry when it decodes to it under encoding.json decode_rule on a queue that may issue it (it may still raise a diagnostic when dispatched)

units.description: Catalogue slices of those entries, sorted

text.description: The initial instruction queue of each queue that has text (the harness Q lines, tsp_sim.c); every other queue starts empty

sram.description: SRAM preload; every other word is zero at reset

dump.description: Words to read after the run (expect.words has exactly these keys)

host.description: The host's script (microarchitecture.md sec. 14) and the ECC and link fault-injection lines (microarchitecture.md secs. 15 and 16): the `H`, `R`, `P` and `F` lines the harness reads after the program, in input order; absent when the vector has none

diagnostics.description: Every diagnostic, in the order the model raises them (the T diag lines of tsp_sim --trace)

trace_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the canonical trace: the `srf` and `sram` events of the run, in the canonical order of microarchitecture.md sec. 12 (each cycle's run of `srf` lines sorted by row E before W, stream, gap), each written as the harness prints it (`T srf ...`, `T sram ...`) followed by a newline. Present for every vector

ext_events.description: The external events of the host path and the ECC findings and the link FEC and matrix-unit check findings in output order: the `T dma`, `T irq`, `T csr`, `T pkt` and `T ecc` lines without the leading "T ", then the `Y` and `X` lines as the harness prints them. Not part of trace_sha256. Absent when the run has none. An implementation compares the list exactly

events.description: Those events, without the leading "T ", in canonical order. Present for the vectors with at most 64 events (the digest covers the rest); an implementation that fails a digest can compare its own events with these on the small vectors
